sentences.en: The notorious rebel was ultimately captured and confined to jail.
sentences.zh: 这个臭名昭著的叛乱分子最终被抓获并关进了监狱。

sentences.en: The notorious dictator abused his privileges to his heart's content.
sentences.zh: 这个臭名昭著的独裁者肆无忌惮地滥用职权。

sentences.en: Jugurtha wasn't afraid of bringing Rome's notorious wrath upon him.
sentences.zh: 朱古尔塔并不害怕招致罗马的臭名昭著的愤怒。
